## What We Do
Stone Works Remodeling transforms outdated bathrooms into beautiful, functional spaces across Metro Detroit. We handle every aspect of bathroom renovation — from the initial design consultation to the final walkthrough — with no subcontracting and no surprises.

### Core Services
**Complete Bathroom Remodeling**
Full gut-and-replace renovations including tile demolition, new waterproofing, custom tile installation, vanity replacement, plumbing fixture upgrades, lighting, and finish work. Most standard projects are completed in 5–10 business days.

**Tub-to-Shower Conversion**
We remove existing bathtubs and install fully custom walk-in showers with tile walls, custom niches, glass enclosures, and linear drains. This is our most popular service across Metro Detroit.

**Walk-in Tub Installation**
Accessible bathtub installations for seniors and homeowners with mobility needs. Includes door-style entry, safety grab bars, therapeutic jets, and anti-slip flooring. We serve the aging-in-place market across Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb Counties.

**Tub Replacement**
Upgrade from an old, stained, or damaged bathtub to a modern soaking tub or freestanding tub with updated surround tile.

**Custom Stone & Tile Work**
Marble, slate, quartzite, granite, and travertine installation for shower walls, floors, vanity tops, and accent features.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Metro Detroit?**
Small bathroom remodel: $8,000–$15,000. Mid-range full remodel: $15,000–$25,000. Luxury master bathroom: $25,000–$60,000+. Tub-to-shower conversion: $4,000–$12,000. All pricing includes labor, materials, and a 5-year warranty.

**How long does a bathroom remodel take?**
Most standard bathroom remodels are completed in 5–10 business days. Larger luxury projects may take 2–3 weeks.

**Are you licensed and insured in Michigan?**
Yes. Stone Works Remodeling is fully licensed and insured in Michigan. All work complies with Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb County building codes.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes, flexible financing is available for qualified buyers.

**What warranty do you offer?**
All projects are backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty.

**Do you serve my city in Metro Detroit?**
We serve all of Metro Detroit including: Detroit, Livonia, Troy, Rochester, Sterling Heights, Royal Oak, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Farmington Hills, Warren, Dearborn, Dearborn Heights, Canton, Novi, Southfield, Westland, Taylor, Shelby Township, Macomb Township, West Bloomfield, Pontiac, Ann Arbor, and surrounding areas.

**What makes Stone Works Remodeling different from Re-Bath or Kaja Construction?**
Stone Works is a local, family-owned business — not a national franchise. We offer custom designs, local expertise, transparent pricing with no franchise markup, and a personal relationship with the owner from start to finish. We match or beat the quality of national brands at lower cost.
